type-cast-silent-bugs.title: Type Cast Silent Bugs
type-cast-silent-bugs.seo_title: Type Cast Silent Bugs | MODH Engineering Skill
type-cast-silent-bugs.seo_description: Type-assertion casts between a database query and consumer code (`as any`, `as unknown as { ... }`, `useState<any[]>`) are silent-bug indicators — they hide column/table drift from the type system. Activates during any type-tightening migration (Drizzle migration, schema rename, ORM swap), any audit that grep-counts these casts, or any "this dashboard's been broken forever, why hasn't it alerted?" investigation.

unslop.title: Unslop
unslop.seo_title: Unslop: Cut AI Tells From Any Writing
unslop.seo_description: Cut AI tells from any writing.

verifying-commit-scope.title: Verifying Commit Scope
verifying-commit-scope.seo_title: Verifying Commit Scope | MODH Engineering Skill
verifying-commit-scope.seo_description: Pre-commit auto-formatters can sweep concurrent agents' unstaged work into your commit when stash/restore mishandles a mixed working tree. Run `git diff --cached --stat` before every commit, treat any unexpected file count as stop-the-world, and recover with `git reset --soft HEAD~1`. Triggers when running `git commit` in any repo with husky/lefthook + lint-staged + auto-format `--write`, especially with concurrent unstaged work in the tree.

wait-what.title: Wait What
wait-what.seo_description: Stop. That last message did not land. Re-pitch it.

webhook-architecture.title: SOLID Webhook Architecture
webhook-architecture.seo_title: SOLID Webhook Architecture — Modh Engineering Skill
webhook-architecture.seo_description: Enforce SOLID principles in webhook architecture for maintainability and extensibility. Enforces registry pattern, single responsibility, and dependency injection.

webhook-observability.title: Webhook Observability
webhook-observability.seo_title: Webhook Observability — Lifecycle Logging, Duration Tracing & Idempotency
webhook-observability.seo_description: Structured observability for webhook handlers. Logger lifecycle, automatic duration tracking, error tracker integration, and idempotency patterns.

webhook-patterns.title: SOLID Webhook Patterns
webhook-patterns.seo_title: SOLID Webhook Patterns — Registry, SRP & Dependency Injection
webhook-patterns.seo_description: Enforce SOLID principles in webhook architecture. Handler registry pattern, one handler per event, dependency injection, and Zod validation.

webhook-temporal-guard.title: Webhook Temporal Guard
webhook-temporal-guard.seo_title: Webhook Temporal Guard — Why Past-Time Payloads Pollute Your DB
webhook-temporal-guard.seo_description: Webhooks announce state from a past moment. When the payload carries a time the action depends on, that time may have moved into the past during delivery — verify before mutating, or you'll write wrong-but-silent state into your DB and customer notifications.

weekly-infra-health-review.title: Weekly Infra Health Review
weekly-infra-health-review.seo_title: Weekly Infra Health Review — Interpret Telemetry, Don't Just Collect It
weekly-infra-health-review.seo_description: A dashboard shows numbers; it never says what changed or what to do. Run a recurring agent that diffs your infra signals week-over-week and posts a short digest ending in 1-3 prioritized actions.

why.title: Why
why.seo_description: Cited answer on why code is shaped the way it is, from every evidence source.

wizard.title: Wizard
wizard.seo_description: Generate an interactive bash wizard for steps only a human can perform.

write-criticality.title: Write Criticality Classification
write-criticality.seo_title: Write Criticality — Classify DB Writes to Eliminate False Data-Loss Alarms
write-criticality.seo_description: Stop alarming on every failed write. Classify writes by durability requirement — tracking, retriable, or critical — and match alarm severity to actual risk.

writing-for-agents.title: Writing for Agents
writing-for-agents.seo_title: Writing for Agents - Modh Engineering Skill
writing-for-agents.seo_description: How to write a document an agent consumes: skills, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md.

build-time-reads.title: Build-Time Reads
build-time-reads.seo_title: Build-Time Reads: Prerendered Pages Freeze the Build's Env
build-time-reads.seo_description: Prerendered Next.js pages read env vars at build time. Declare them in turbo.json so build and runtime agree, and read files in a shape the bundler can trace.

catalog-driven-resolver.title: Catalog-Driven Resolver
catalog-driven-resolver.seo_title: Catalog-Driven Resolver: A Policy Table Nobody Reads Is a Comment
catalog-driven-resolver.seo_description: When a catalog declares a per-type rule but each call site computes the result itself, the table and production drift apart. Make the table the only code path that produces the result.

customer-language.title: Customer Language
customer-language.seo_title: Customer Language: Plain Words for UI Copy, Errors and Help Text
customer-language.seo_description: Write and review customer-facing UI copy, help text, error messages, onboarding and product docs in plain language. Use it whenever product language is added or changed.

decision-page-to-ticket.title: Decision Page to Ticket
decision-page-to-ticket.seo_title: Decision Page to Ticket: Agree on One Page, Then Build From the Ticket
decision-page-to-ticket.seo_description: Turn a scoping question into one shared decision page that engineers and non-engineers can judge, often as mockups. Then write a ticket an engineer can build from without asking.

deploy-source-guard.title: Deploy Source Guard
deploy-source-guard.seo_title: Deploy Source Guard: Pin Checkout Deploys to One Commit and Prove It
deploy-source-guard.seo_description: A deploy that builds from a live working checkout can ship code that matches no commit. Pin the deploy to one commit, then prove the running build is that commit.

durable-seed-floor.title: Durable Seed Floor
durable-seed-floor.seo_title: Durable Seed Floor: A Self-Healing Data Floor for Read-Only E2E Gates
durable-seed-floor.seo_description: Read-only E2E tests that assert over shared data fail when a cleanup sweep removes it. Upsert the data they need in global setup, in a namespace the cleanup cannot match.

gauntlet-loop.title: Gauntlet Loop
gauntlet-loop.seo_title: Gauntlet Loop: Run Big Agent Tasks as a Bounded Build and Judge Cycle
gauntlet-loop.seo_description: Write one prompt that runs an ambitious goal as a bounded build, inspect, judge and repeat cycle. The metric is one the agent cannot fudge, and the builder never grades its own work.

header-yields-to-task-surface.title: Header Yields to the Task Surface
header-yields-to-task-surface.seo_title: Header Yields to the Task Surface: Keep Hide-on-Scroll Headers Off the Form
header-yields-to-task-surface.seo_description: A hide-on-scroll header must stay hidden while the page's main task, such as a scheduler, checkout or form, sits under it. Measure where it would rest, then test that it stays hidden.

portable-component-bundle.title: Portable Component Bundle
portable-component-bundle.seo_title: Portable Component Bundle: Ship a React Library Outside Its App Build
portable-component-bundle.seo_description: Ship React components to a docs site, embed or CMS preview as classic scripts plus one stylesheet, without a second copy of React or unstyled Tailwind classes.

provider-neutral-sync-policy.title: Provider-Neutral Sync Policy
provider-neutral-sync-policy.seo_title: Provider-Neutral Sync Policy: Decide Reuse Once, Prove the Merge First
provider-neutral-sync-policy.seo_description: Put the rule that decides whether an integration reuses, creates or leaves an external record in one pure module that every provider adapter calls. Prove two providers' rules match before merging them.

record-the-no-op.title: Record the No-Op
record-the-no-op.seo_title: Record the No-Op: A Deliberate Skip Needs a Durable Record
record-the-no-op.seo_description: A skipped sync, an empty job run or an ignored webhook is an outcome. Record it on the entity it concerns, deduplicated per reason and time window, and prove the write works against the real store.

retry-vs-reporting-classifier.title: Retry Classifier vs Reporting Classifier
retry-vs-reporting-classifier.seo_title: Retry vs Reporting Classifier: Keep 'Retry?' and 'Whose Fault?' Apart
retry-vs-reporting-classifier.seo_description: Keep the retry classifier narrow. Add a separate reporting-only classifier that files unreachable dependencies, such as a full database pool, as one degradation group in your error tracker.

satellite-domain-sign-in.title: Satellite Domain Sign-In
satellite-domain-sign-in.seo_title: Satellite Domain Sign-In: One App, Two Domain Families, One Sign-In
satellite-domain-sign-in.seo_description: Serve one app on two domain families with one sign-in. Configure the satellite domain in your auth provider, and give every hand-off from the second domain its own way back.

session-token-claim-budget.title: Session Token Claim Budget
session-token-claim-budget.seo_title: Session Token Claim Budget: Every Claim Spends Cookie Space
session-token-claim-budget.seo_description: A session token stored in a cookie has a size budget, and every custom claim spends it. Give each claim a named reader and a size bound before you edit a production token template.

type-the-parse-input.title: Type the Parse Input
type-the-parse-input.seo_title: Type the Parse Input: Typecheck What Your Code Hands to Zod
type-the-parse-input.seo_description: A runtime validator takes unknown, so the object your typed code hands to schema.parse() is never typechecked. Type the hand-off as z.input<typeof schema> to catch drift at build time.
